environment.description: Same Flask application packaged as a container image and deployed behind an AWS Lambda function URL. The function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda function's resource-based policy grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalServiceCallerRole with condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching o-abc123def4. Unauthenticated HTTP requests to the function URL receive HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} before reaching the Flask handler. The Lambda Web Adapter (LWA) proxies SigV4-authenticated requests to the Flask app on localhost:8080 inside the execution environment. Note: the session cookie mechanism in the code is vestigial in this deployment since all callers must present valid SigV4 signatures; browser-originated cross-site requests cannot produce valid AWS SigV4 headers.

config.deployment: AWS Lambda function URL with lambda-web-adapter
config.network: Lambda in VPC with Redis endpoint access
